notes:
**0.13.8**
- **Prefix and Digits take effect when you change them.** Since 0.1.1 the next file copied the style of the highest-numbered file already in the folder, so a folder with `SNAP-019.png` and Digits set to 4 still got `SNAP-020.png`. Now, once you change **Prefix** or **Digits**, new captures (pictures, recordings, GIFs, scrolling captures and secure captures) are named with them: `SNAP-0020.png`. The number still comes from the folder (the highest plus one: it never restarts and is never used twice) and a number that needs more digits is written in full. Nothing changes until you change one of the two: an install that never touches them keeps following the folder, and no existing file is renamed. **Next file** shows the real name as you change them, and a line under **File name** says when the folder's own style is still in charge. The Digits help text now reads "How many digits the number has, padded with zeros. 0 means no padding."

Full release notes: https://github.com/atlas9-ai/a9snap-releases/releases
